python -c "
import parse
import re

errors = []

# R1: dt_format_to_regex
try:
    pat = parse.dt_format_to_regex('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    assert re.match(pat, '2023-01-05 10:30:45')
    assert re.match(pat, '2023-1-5 10:30:45')  # single digit
    assert re.match(pat, '2023-01-05 10:30:45.123456')  # has colon
    assert re.match(parse.dt_format_to_regex('%z'), '+05:30')
    assert re.match(parse.dt_format_to_regex('%z'), 'Z')
    assert re.match(parse.dt_format_to_regex('%z'), '+0530')
    assert 'dt_format_to_regex' in parse.__all__
    print('R1 OK')
except Exception as e:
    errors.append(f'R1 failed: {e}')

# R1 also: Parser class handles single-digit days/months, colons, %z
try:
    r = parse.parse('{:ti}', '2023-1-5')
    assert r[0] == parse.datetime(2023, 1, 5)
    r = parse.parse('{:ti}', '2023-01-05T10:30:45')
    assert r[0] == parse.datetime(2023, 1, 5, 10, 30, 45)
    r = parse.parse('{:ti}', '2023-01-05T10:30:45+05:30')
    assert r[0] == parse.datetime(2023, 1, 5, 10, 30, 45, tzinfo=parse.FixedTzOffset(330, '+05:30'))
    r = parse.parse('{:ti}', '2023-01-05T10:30:45Z')
    assert r[0] == parse.datetime(2023, 1, 5, 10, 30, 45, tzinfo=parse.timezone.utc)
    print('R1 Parser OK')
except Exception as e:
    errors.append(f'R1 Parser failed: {e}')

# R2: public API
try:
    assert parse.FixedTzOffset is not None
    assert parse.RepeatedNameError is not None
    assert callable(parse.date_convert)
    assert callable(parse.extract_format)
    for name in ['FixedTzOffset', 'RepeatedNameError', 'date_convert', 'extract_format']:
        assert name in parse.__all__, f'{name} not in __all__'
    print('R2 OK')
except Exception as e:
    errors.append(f'R2 failed: {e}')

# R3: formatter property
try:
    p = parse.Parser('{name:d}')
    f = p.formatter
    assert isinstance(f, dict)
    assert 'format' in f
    assert 'extra_types' in f
    assert 'case_sensitive' in f
    print('R3 OK')
except Exception as e:
    errors.append(f'R3 failed: {e}')

# R4: %f various digits
try:
    r = parse.parse('{:ti}', '2023-01-15T10:30:45.1')
    assert r[0].microsecond == 100000
    r = parse.parse('{:ti}', '2023-01-15T10:30:45.12')
    assert r[0].microsecond == 120000
    r = parse.parse('{:ti}', '2023-01-15T10:30:45.123')
    assert r[0].microsecond == 123000
    r = parse.parse('{:ti}', '2023-01-15T10:30:45.123456')
    assert r[0].microsecond == 123456
    print('R4 OK')
except Exception as e:
    errors.append(f'R4 failed: {e}')

# R5: hyphens in field names
try:
    r = parse.parse('{my-field}', 'hello')
    assert r['my-field'] == 'hello'
    r = parse.parse('{my-field:}', 'hello')
    assert r['my-field'] == 'hello'
    r = parse.parse('{my-field:d}', '42')
    assert r['my-field'] == 42
    # Test extract_format with hyphens (called properly)
    fmt = parse.extract_format('d', {})
    assert fmt is not None
    print('R5 OK')
except Exception as e:
    errors.append(f'R5 failed: {e}')

# R6: grouping characters
try:
    r = parse.parse('{:,d}', '1,234')
    assert r[0] == 1234
    r = parse.parse('{:_d}', '1_234')
    assert r[0] == 1234
    r = parse.parse('{val:,d}', '1,234')
    assert r['val'] == 1234
    r = parse.parse('{val:_d}', '1_234')
    assert r['val'] == 1234
    # Test extract_format with grouping
    fmt = parse.extract_format(',d', {})
    assert fmt['grouping'] == ','
    fmt = parse.extract_format('_d', {})
    assert fmt['grouping'] == '_'
    print('R6 OK')
except Exception as e:
    errors.append(f'R6 failed: {e}')

if errors:
    print('ERRORS:', errors)
else:
    print('ALL REQUIREMENTS VERIFIED SUCCESSFULLY')
"
